scenes.a_nursery: 1955 San Francisco hospital nursery at night: a newborn baby boy wrapped in a white blanket lying alone in a small hospital bassinet, a nurse's silhouette at the doorway, soft lamp light, quiet and lonely mood
scenes.a_father: 1950s Wisconsin farmhouse living room: a stern, ill elderly German-American father in an armchair with a blanket over his knees, pointing sharply toward the door, his young adult daughter standing before him in tears
scenes.a_lawyer: 1955 doctor's office in San Francisco: a well-dressed lawyer couple in 1950s suit and coat standing up and turning away toward the door, the kindly doctor behind the desk holding an open file, an empty baby crib in the corner
scenes.a_paulclara: 1955 small apartment in San Francisco's Sunset district near the ocean: a muscular tattooed mechanic in his thirties with slicked-back hair and his kind dark-haired Armenian-American wife gently holding a newborn baby boy together, happy tears, simple furniture, fog outside the window
scenes.a_unsigned: Close-up of 1950s adoption papers on a wooden desk with a fountain pen lying untouched beside them, a young woman's hand hovering hesitantly above, tense quiet mood, papers show only illegible scribble lines
scenes.a_campus: 1954 University of Wisconsin campus in autumn: a young American woman graduate student with a 1950s hairstyle walking close and smiling with a handsome young Syrian man in a suit carrying books, falling leaves, romantic but uneasy mood
scenes.a_wedding: Snowy evening just after Christmas 1955 outside a small Catholic church in Green Bay, Wisconsin: a young bride in a modest white dress and a young man in a dark suit walking down the church steps, warm light from the open doors, falling snow, bittersweet mood
scenes.b_hallway: Late 1960s rough California middle school hallway: a skinny lonely dark-haired boy of about eleven pressed against the lockers while a group of bigger older teenagers loom over him, one toying with a pocket knife, harsh fluorescent light
scenes.b_ultimatum: 1960s California kitchen at dinner: a dark-haired boy of about twelve standing up at the table with fists clenched, firmly telling his worried working-class parents something; the father a mechanic in a work shirt, the mother with bookkeeping ledgers next to her plate
scenes.b_bills: Late night in a modest 1960s kitchen: a working-class couple bent over a pile of household bills, a bank passbook, a hand-drawn map of school districts and a small photo of a ranch house, a single lamp, tired but determined faces
scenes.b_garage: 1960s suburban California garage with the roll-up door open at dusk: a father in overalls working under the hood of an old car while his teenage son sits at a small workbench soldering electronic parts beside him, warm light
scenes.b_factory: 1976 suburban house turned into a small workshop: two young men with long hair soldering green circuit boards at a kitchen table covered in electronic parts, a young pregnant woman helping, boxes of components stacked in the hallway and an open garage beyond
scenes.a_mother_leave: 1955 San Francisco hospital corridor at dawn: a young woman of twenty-three in a 1950s coat walking away down a long empty corridor carrying a small suitcase, turning her head back toward a nursery window, long shadows, heartbreaking mood
scenes.a_pink: Still life in a 1950s nursery: a tiny pink baby girl's dress and a pink knitted bonnet laid neatly on an empty crib, an adoption folder beside them, soft window light, quiet symbolic mood
scenes.a_paul_engine: 1950s: a muscular young mechanic with tattoos on his forearms and slicked-back hair, resembling a 1950s film star, working on a car engine under the open hood in a small San Francisco garage, wrench in hand, confident and gentle face
scenes.a_clara_ledger: 1950s office: a kind dark-haired Armenian-American woman in her thirties working as a bookkeeper at a wooden desk, writing neatly in large ledger books with an adding machine beside her, warm lamp light
scenes.a_window: Night in a small 1955 San Francisco rented room: a young woman sitting by a rain-streaked window holding unsigned papers in her lap, looking out at the city lights, conflicted and waiting, cold blue light with a warm lamp
scenes.b_school_ext: Late 1960s rough public middle school in California: low concrete buildings, chain-link fence with a hole, graffiti-like scribbles without readable letters, groups of tough older teenagers loitering, a small boy with a book bag walking in alone, overcast
scenes.b_fight: Late 1960s middle school yard: a crowd of teenagers circled around two boys fighting, dust rising, a younger skinny boy watching from the edge with alarm, dramatic angle
scenes.b_realestate: Early 1960s California suburb: a working-class man in an ill-fitting new suit standing awkwardly beside a for-sale signboard (blank, no letters) in front of a house, holding a folder, uneasy smile, clouds gathering
